title: Vanguards of Healthcare: Resmed’s Expanding Within Sleep Health
summary: “I almost think of, you know, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and these other areas as verticals. Sleep is a horizontal and it can impact all of the above,” Resmed CEO Mick Farrell explains to Bloomberg Intelligence. In this Vanguards of Healthcare episode, Farrell sits down with BI analyst Matt Henriksson to discuss how Resmed became the market leader in sleep apnea treatment and how it’s investing in assets like Noctrix Health to expand its sleep-health presence into restless legs syndrome.

title: Tech Disruptors: Vast Data Tackles Enterprise AI Security Needs

summary: “We don’t think the dollar will knock it out of the park,” says Daragh Maher, senior FX strategist at HSBC, as he discusses the “ambiguous relationship” he sees between the US dollar and Treasury yields. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Stock Futures Drop as Yields Climb Further, Oil Rises
summary: Stock futures slumped Thursday amid a surge in bond yields and a fresh climb in oil prices, which is dragging down the broader market despite renewed optimism about AI after Meta Platforms Inc.’s rollout of a popular new tool.

title: US Stocks Fall as 30-Year Yield Hits 2004 High: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks fell after fresh gains in oil prices fueled further selling in bonds and lifted 30-year Treasury yields to the highest since 2004.

title: Nigeria T-Bill Yields Hit 2026 Low After Jumbo Interest-Rate Cut
summary: Nigeria’s central bank sold short-dated debt at the lowest yields this year as investors rushed to lock in returns after the biggest interest-rate cut in almost two decades stoked expectations that future offerings will pay less.

title: Singapore Court Strips Control of Radiant World From Founder
summary: A Singapore court appointed KPMG restructuring executives to take charge of Radiant World on Thursday, granting an application by creditor Mizuho Bank Ltd., which has accused the trader of alleged fraud linked to iron ore receivables.

title: Proxy Adviser Glass Lewis Merges With Clarity AI: ESG Investing
summary: Glass Lewis & Co. is merging with European-focused ESG data and analytics firm Clarity AI, as the proxy adviser expands its footprint in a market where investor demand for managing climate and sustainability risks are on the rise.

title: Dangote Refinery CEO on Nigeria IPO, Diesel Inventories
summary: David Bird, chief executive officer of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals Fze, discusses the firm's initial public offering in Nigeria, expansion plans and the outlook for diesel inventories. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Blackstone Inc. is launching a private-markets fund for retail clients outside the US, as alternative money managers jockey to court investors worldwide beyond large institutions.

title: Indian Insurance, Bank Stocks Erase $14 Billion on Fee Cap Plan

title: Europe’s Diesel Prices Race Ahead of US on Export-Ban Risks

title: China Shuns Costly Brazil Soybeans Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
summary: Chinese soybean imports from Brazil have slowed to a trickle as high prices squeeze crushing margins, raising the risk of a supply crunch in the world’s biggest consumer if the slowdown persists.

title: European Stocks Dip as Bonds Sell Off Globally and Oil Climbs
summary: European stocks edged lower as traders monitored a spike in oil prices and a global selloff in bonds, with the average yield rising to levels not seen for almost two decades.

title: Trump, Xi Buy Time on Trade With Truce Extension
summary: As US President Donald Trump greeted China's Xi Jinping on Wednesday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that an agreement struck last year by the nations will run an additional two months until Jan. 10. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Falls as Traders Monitor Oil Rebound and Fed Rate Path
